style: Children's picture-book illustration, flat shapes with soft gentle grain, thick clean rounded outlines, warm friendly faces, natural everyday colours. Original, not based on any existing character. No text, no letters, no numbers, no signs with writing, no logos, no brands, no watermark. Gentle, safe and cheerful: nothing scary or violent.
background: A full simple background scene, wide landscape picture, everyday British setting. The scene is empty: no people and no animals. Leave open space in the lower middle for characters to stand.
cutout: One single sticker, the whole figure shown from head to toe, centred, isolated on a plain flat pure white background. No ground, no shadow, no scenery, nothing else in the picture.
keep: Keep exactly the same character, face, hair, skin, clothes, drawing style and colours as this picture, on the same plain flat pure white background with no ground and no shadow. No text, no letters, no numbers. Now show them in a new pose:
